title: A Witness for the Ledger
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Silas Ashgrove, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
